en.title: Lindy: AI teammate for connected team work
en.summary: Lindy is an AI teammate for delegated work across connected tools, shared context and scheduled routines. Compare approvals, credit use and per-seat cost with n8n and Make before choosing it.
en.detail: Lindy now presents itself as an AI teammate for teams rather than only a visual agent builder. Its public pages describe work across connected tools, shared context, meeting follow-up and recurring routines. This is a candidate when a team wants to delegate repeatable operational work and can review what the assistant is allowed to read or change. Compare it with n8n and Make on setup effort, integration scope, human approval, failure recovery and total running cost. Lindy's public pricing offers a short free-credit trial and paid seats drawing from a shared credit pool; credit consumption varies by task. This directory has not tested account checkout, connected-app permissions, task accuracy or data processing in a real workspace. Confirm approvals, contract terms and actual credit use in your target account before relying on an irreversible workflow. The earlier noindex search shell at this URL is not evidence of a separate listed entity or a successful product test.

Teams willing to measure credit use and review connected-app permissions
notIdealFor: Buyers seeking a permanently free plan after the short trial

cn.title: Lindy：跨工具协作的 AI 队友
